title: Codex/Claude sessions lose TermAl MCP after restart — boot resumes runtimes before the HTTP server is listening + base_url is set
outcome:
SYSTEMATIC, confirmed in code + reproduced by the user (CodexMCP / session-3309 had zero TermAl MCP
tools after a restart; the agent reported the bridge absent).

BOOT ORDER (src/main.rs run_server):
  126: let state = AppState::new(cwd)?;           // boot work runs here
  132: let listener = TcpListener::bind(address)?; // HTTP server binds
  139: state.set_local_http_base_url(http://{bound}); // base_url set ONLY NOW

AppState::new -> new_with_paths (src/app_boot.rs) ends with runtime-resuming work BEFORE the server is
up: seed_hidden_claude_spares (357), reconcile_delegation_waits_after_boot (358),
resume_pending_orchestrator_transitions (368), dispatch_orphaned_queued_prompts (371). Any of these can
resume a Codex session, which launches/attaches the SHARED Codex app-server and bakes the MCP config from
local_http_base_url() — still the DEFAULT (set_local_http_base_url hasn't run) — pointing at a backend
that isn't listening yet (bind is at main.rs:132). The MCP config is passed on thread/start AND
thread/resume (src/codex.rs:1004,1015), but the shared app-server comes up with the TermAl MCP bridge
unable to reach the backend. Because ONE app-server hosts every local Codex session, ALL of them lose
MCP — including sessions the user resumes later. Claude spares (357) have the same exposure via
termal_delegation_mcp_claude_config_json.

FIX: bring the HTTP listener up + set_local_http_base_url BEFORE any boot-time runtime resume/spawn. I.e.
split AppState::new into (a) pure load (no resume/spawn) and (b) a post-listen boot step that runs
seed_hidden_claude_spares + reconcile_delegation_waits_after_boot + resume_pending_orchestrator_transitions
+ dispatch_orphaned_queued_prompts, invoked from run_server AFTER main.rs:139. Setting base_url earlier is
necessary but NOT sufficient — the backend must be LISTENING before the shared Codex app-server / Claude
spares spawn their MCP bridges. Add a regression test asserting no runtime spawn/resume happens before the
base_url is set / listener is bound.
disposal_reason: Backlog triage w-930e4d333f07 (Architect1 batch 1a, spot-checked by Termal::Fable2): CLOSE-DONE. Runtimes resume after listen (src/app_boot.rs:855-882), landed in fa13d81 (ancestor of master f7db2c58). Closed by evidence.
